Only `title`, `author`, `description`, `patch` and `added` are required, remove what you do not need. `mercenary`, `hero`, `talents`, `army` and a ` ```bo ` block need `faction`, `talents` also needs `mercenary`.

````md
---
title: Exalted Arandi
author: Your name
patch: 18
added: 2026-11-11
description: Strong build order to take map control early and snowball, choking the opponent and keeping them off the XP towers.
faction: the-legion
mercenary: arandi
style: one-base
hero: Galavax
talents: 1222211
army: [Galavax, Kraegar, Exalted, Arandi Judgement]
vs: { protectorate: 4, grell: 2, the-legion: 4, the-xol: 5 }
strengths:
  - Very strong early game that needs little micro.
  - The Galavax and Exalted combo snowballs.
weaknesses:
  - Weak against Skrells.
---

```bo
1. Idal Conduit + 2 Bestiary (loop Exalted) (-> 3 Legion Labourer) + Citadel
   -> Idal Conduit + Altar
   -> Kraegar + Hallowed Strike
   goal: Take map control and the 3 XP towers
2. when Kraegar starts: Garrison Tower + Idal Conduit + Terror Tower + Armory + Arandi Penumbra
   -> More Feed + Explosive Warhead
   goal: Kraegar out, take B2 and fast tech
```

## Key timings

- Take the mid XP tower first with Galavax, then a side tower.
- Your first two Exalted come out when the enemy hero goes for the mid tower, so you can snipe it.

## Against Skrells and air

- Mix in Thralls from B2 on.

## If they go Skrells

```bo
1. Barracks -> 4 Thrall
   goal: Hold the air harass
```
````
